description: Get facts for one storage account or all storage accounts within a resource group.

parameters.name: ad_user
parameters.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: adfs_authority_url
parameters.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

parameters.name: api_profile
parameters.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of latest is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack. Default: "latest"

parameters.name: auth_mode
parameters.description: The mode in which to run the command. login mode will directly use your login credentials for the authentication. The legacy key mode will attempt to query for an account key if no authentication parameters for the account are provided. Can also be set via the environment variable AZURE_STORAGE_AUTH_MODE. Choices: "key" ← (default) "login"

parameters.name: auth_source
parameters.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE environment variable. When set to auto (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> env -> credential_file -> cli. When set to env, the credentials will be read from the environment variables When set to credential_file, it will read the profile from ~/.azure/credentials. When set to cli, the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if more than one is present otherwise the default az cli subscription is used. When set to msi, the host machine must be an azure resource with an enabled MSI extension. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if the resource is granted access to more than one subscription, otherwise the first subscription is chosen. The msi was added in Ansible 2.6. Choices: "auto" ← (default) "cli" "credential_file" "env" "msi"

parameters.name: cert_validation_mode
parameters.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing ignore. Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION environment variable. Choices: "ignore" "validate"

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the AZURE_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

parameters.name: cloud_environment
parameters.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, AzureChinaCloud, AzureUSGovernment), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT environment variable. Default: "AzureCloud"

parameters.name: disable_instance_discovery
parameters.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validation of the authority is disabled. As a result, it is crucial to ensure that the configured authority host is valid and trustworthy. Set via credential file profile or the AZURE_DISABLE_INSTANCE_DISCOVERY environment variable. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: log_mode
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: log_path
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Only show results for a specific account.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

parameters.name: resource_group
parameters.description: Limit results to a resource group. Required when filtering by name.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: show_blob_cors
parameters.description: Show the blob CORS settings for each blob related to the storage account. Querying all storage accounts will take a long time. Choices: false true

parameters.name: show_connection_string
parameters.description: Show the connection string for each of the storageaccount’s endpoints. For convenient usage, show_connection_string will also show the access keys for each of the storageaccount’s endpoints. Note that it will cost a lot of time when list all storageaccount rather than query a single one. Choices: false true

parameters.name: show_georeplication_stats
parameters.description: Show the Geo Replication Stats for each storage account. Using this option on an account that does not support georeplication will cause a delay in getting results. Choices: false true

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Limit results by providing a list of tags. Format tags as ‘key’ or ‘key:value’.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: thumbprint
parameters.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in x509_certificate_path. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if x509_certificate_path is defined.

parameters.name: x509_certificate_path
parameters.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

examples:
- name: Get facts for one account
  azure_rm_storageaccount_info:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    name: clh0002

- name: Get facts for all accounts in a resource group
  azure_rm_storageaccount_info:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup

- name: Get facts for all accounts by tags
  azure_rm_storageaccount_info:
    tags:
      - testing
      - foo:bar

return_values.name: azure_storageaccounts
return_values.description: List of storage account dicts. Returned: always Sample: [{"id": "/subscriptions/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/myResourceGroups/testing/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/testaccount001", "location": "eastus2", "name": "testaccount001", "properties": {"accountType": "Standard_LRS", "creationTime": "2016-03-28T02:46:58.290113Z", "primaryEndpoints": {"blob": "https://testaccount001.blob.core.windows.net/", "file": "https://testaccount001.file.core.windows.net/", "queue": "https://testaccount001.queue.core.windows.net/", "table": "https://testaccount001.table.core.windows.net/"}, "primaryLocation": "eastus2", "provisioningState": "Succeeded", "statusOfPrimary": "Available"}, "tags": {}, "type": "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts"}]

return_values.name: storageaccounts
return_values.description: List of storage account dicts in resource module’s parameter format. Returned: always

return_values.name: access_tier
return_values.description: The access tier for this storage account. Returned: always Sample: "Hot"

return_values.name: account_type
return_values.description: Type of storage account. Standard_ZRS and Premium_LRS accounts cannot be changed to other account types. Other account types cannot be changed to Standard_ZRS or Premium_LRS. Returned: always Sample: "Standard_ZRS"

return_values.name: allow_blob_public_access
return_values.description: Public access to all blobs or containers in the storage account allowed or disallowed. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: allow_cross_tenant_replication
return_values.description: Allow or disallow cross AAD tenant object replication. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: allow_shared_key_access
return_values.description: Indicates whether the storage account permits requests to be authorized with the account access key via Shared Key. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: custom_domain
return_values.description: User domain assigned to the storage account. Must be a dictionary with name and use_sub_domain keys where name is the CNAME source. Returned: always

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: CNAME source. Returned: always Sample: "testaccount"

return_values.name: use_sub_domain
return_values.description: Whether to use sub domain. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: default_to_o_auth_authentication
return_values.description: A boolean flag which indicates whether the default authentication is OAuth or not. The default interpretation is false for this property. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: enable_nfs_v3
return_values.description: NFS 3.0 protocol. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: encryption
return_values.description: The encryption settings on the storage account. Returned: always

return_values.name: encryption_identity
return_values.description: The identity to be used with service-side encryption at rest. Returned: always Sample: {"encryption_user_assigned_identity": "/subscriptions/xxxx/resourcegroups/testRG/providers/Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/identity-11"}

return_values.name: key_source
return_values.description: The encryption keySource (provider). Returned: always Sample: "Microsoft.Storage"

return_values.name: key_vault_properties
return_values.description: Dict of Microsoft Keyvault properties. Create the Storage account with encryption enabled with Microsoft KeyVault for CMK. Returned: always Sample: {"key_name": "testkey", "key_vault_uri": "https://vxxxxxxx01.vault.azure.net/", "key_version": "0bd2556671c64fc998xxxxeb12"}

return_values.name: require_infrastructure_encryption
return_values.description: A boolean indicating whether or not the service applies a secondary layer of encryption with platform managed keys for data at rest. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: services
return_values.description: List of services which support encryption. Returned: always

return_values.name: blob
return_values.description: The encryption function of the blob storage service. Returned: always Sample: {"enabled": true}

return_values.name: file
return_values.description: The encryption function of the file storage service. Returned: always Sample: {"enabled": true}

return_values.name: queue
return_values.description: The encryption function of the queue storage service. Returned: always Sample: {"enabled": true}

return_values.name: table
return_values.description: The encryption function of the table storage service. Returned: always Sample: {"enabled": true}

return_values.name: failover_in_progress
return_values.description: Status indicating the storage account is currently failing over to its secondary location. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: georeplication_stats
return_values.description: Parameters related to the status of geo-replication. This will be null on accounts that don’t support geo-replication. Returned: always

return_values.name: can_failover
return_values.description: Property indicating if fail over is supported by the account. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: last_sync_time
return_values.description: Writes to the primary before this time are guaranteed to be replicated to the secondary. Returned: success Sample: "2023-04-10T21:22:15+00:00"

return_values.name: sync_status
return_values.description: Property showing status of the secondary region. Known values are “Live”, “Bootstrap”, and “Unavailable”. Returned: success Sample: "Live"

return_values.name: https_only
return_values.description: Allows https traffic only to storage service when set to true. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: Resource ID. Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/resourceGroups/myResourceGroup/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/t estaccount001"

return_values.name: immutable_storage_with_versioning
return_values.description: The property is immutable and can only be set to true at the account creation time. When set to true, it enables object level immutability for all the containers in the account by default. Returned: when-used

return_values.name: enabled
return_values.description: A boolean flag which enables account-level immutability. All the containers under such an account have object-level immutability enabled by default. Returned: when-used Sample: true

return_values.name: immutability_policy
return_values.description: Specifies the default account-level immutability policy which is inherited and applied to objects that do not possess an explicit immutability policy at the object level. The object-level immutability policy has higher precedence than the container-level immutability policy, which has a higher precedence than the account-level immutability policy. Returned: when-used

return_values.name: allow_protected_append_writes
return_values.description: This property can only be changed for disabled and unlocked time-based retention policies. When enabled, new blocks can be written to an append blob while maintaining immutability protection and compliance. Only new blocks can be added and any existing blocks cannot be modified or deleted. Returned: when-used Sample: true

return_values.name: immutability_period_since_creation_in_days
return_values.description: The immutability period for the blobs in the container since the policy creation, in days. Returned: when-used Sample: true

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: The ImmutabilityPolicy state defines the mode of the policy. Returned: when-used Sample: "Unlocked"

return_values.name: is_hns_enabled
return_values.description: Account HierarchicalNamespace enabled if sets to true. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: kind
return_values.description: The kind of storage. Returned: always Sample: "Storage"

return_values.name: large_file_shares_state
return_values.description: Allow large file shares if sets to Enabled. Returned: always Sample: "Enabled"

return_values.name: location
return_values.description: Valid Azure location. Defaults to location of the resource group. Returned: always Sample: "eastus"

return_values.name: minimum_tls_version
return_values.description: The minimum TLS version permitted on requests to storage. Returned: always Sample: "TLS1_2"

return_values.name: network_acls
return_values.description: A set of firewall, virtual network and resource instance rules. Returned: always Sample: {"bypass": "AzureServices", "default_action": "Deny", "ip_rules": [{"action": "Allow", "value": "1.2.3.4"}, {"action": "Allow", "value": "123.234.123.0/24"}], "resource_access_rules": [{"resource_id": "/subscriptions/.../BackupVaults/myBackupVault", "tenant_id": "myTenantId"}], "virtual_network_rules": [{"action": "Allow", "id": "/subscriptions/mySubscriptionId/resourceGroups/myResourceGroup/ providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/myVnet/subnets/mySubnet"}]}

return_values.name: primary_endpoints
return_values.description: URLs to retrieve a public blob, file, queue, or table object. Note that Standard_ZRS and Premium_LRS accounts only return the blob endpoint. Returned: always

return_values.name: connectionstring
return_values.description: Connectionstring of the blob endpoint. Returned: always Sample: "DefaultEndpointsProtocol=https;EndpointSuffix=core.windows.net;AccountName=X;AccountKey=X;BlobEndpoint=X"

return_values.name: endpoint
return_values.description: The primary blob endpoint. Returned: always Sample: "https://testaccount001.blob.core.windows.net/"

return_values.name: key
return_values.description: The account key for the primary_endpoints Returned: always Sample: "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"

return_values.name: primary_location
return_values.description: The location of the primary data center for the storage account. Returned: always Sample: "eastus"

return_values.name: provisioning_state
return_values.description: The status of the storage account at the time the operation was called. Possible values include Creating, ResolvingDNS, Succeeded. Returned: always Sample: "Succeeded"

return_values.name: public_network_access
return_values.description: Public network access to Storage Account allowed or disallowed. Returned: always Sample: "Enabled"

return_values.description: The location of the geo-replicated secondary for the storage account. Only available if the account_type=Standard_GRS or account_type=Standard_RAGRS. Returned: always Sample: "westus"

return_values.name: static_website
return_values.description: Static website configuration for the storage account. Returned: always

return_values.description: The default name of the index page under each directory. Returned: always Sample: "index.html"

return_values.name: status_of_secondary

return_values.name: tags
